Kept on this phone, sealed by the security chip, since a backup written at three in the morning cannot stop to ask for it. Without it the backups cannot be opened, here or anywhere.
Contacts, calls and texts in open formats

This second folder is readable by anything that finds it: it is not encrypted, and it is meant not to be, so that any program can open it in ten years. It holds your contacts, your call log and your texts. It does not hold your profiles, your call filtering, your pinned conversations or your Seca Link keys, because no portable format carries them.
